commands.result_summary:
1	# Add Queue Item
2	
3	`UiPath.Core.Activities.AddQueueItem`
4	
5	Adds a new item in the queue. The status of the item will be New.
6	
7	**Package:** `UiPath.System.Activities`
8	**Category:** Queues
9	
10	## Properties
11	
12	### Input
13	
14	| Name | Display Name | Kind | Type | Required | Default | Description |
15	|------|-------------|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
16	| `QueueType` | Queue name | InArgument | `string` | Yes | — | The name of the queue to add the item to. |
17	| `DeferDate` | Postpone | InArgument | `DateTime` | No | null | The earliest date and time after which the item may be processed. |
18	| `DueDate` | Deadline | InArgument | `DateTime` | No | null | The latest date and time by which the item should be processed. |
19	| `Priority` | Priority | InArgument | `QueueItemPriority` | No | `Normal` | The priority of the queue item. Accepts a literal `QueueItemPriority` value or a bound expression. |
20	| `Reference` | Reference | InArgument | `string` | No | null | An external reference tag for the queue item. |
21	| `ItemInformationCollection` | Item Information Collection | InArgument | `Dictionary<string, object>` | No | null | A variable dictionary containing the item's specific data. Used when item data is bound at runtime. |
22	
23	### Configuration
24	
25	| Name | Display Name | Type | Default | Description |
26	|------|-------------|------|---------|-------------|
27	| `ItemInformation` | Item Information | `Dictionary<string, InArgument>` | — | The inline key-value collection of specific data for the queue item. Keys can be auto-populated from the Orchestrator queue schema. |
28	
29	## Valid Configurations
30	
31	- Either `ItemInformation` (inline dictionary) or `ItemInformationCollection` (variable) may be used to supply specific data. Both can be set simultaneously and their values are merged at runtime.
32	- When `QueueType` is set to a literal queue name, the designer offers a **Refresh Arguments** menu action on `ItemInformation` to auto-populate keys from the Orchestrator queue JSON schema.
33	
34	### Enum Reference
35	
36	**QueueItemPriority**
37	
38	| Value | Description |
39	|-------|-------------|
40	| `Low` | Lower than normal priority. |
41	| `Normal` | Default priority. |
42	| `High` | Higher than normal priority. |
43	
44	## XAML Example
45	
46	Minimal — literal queue name, no specific data:
47	
48	```xml
49	<ui:AddQueueItem
50	    QueueType="InvoiceProcessing"
51	    Priority="Normal"
52	    Reference="INV-2024-001"
53	    DueDate="[DateTime.Now.AddDays(1)]"
54	    xmlns:ui="clr-namespace:UiPath.Core.Activities;assembly=UiPath.System.Activities" />
55	```
56	
57	With `ItemInformation` carrying mixed-type specific data (string, double, boolean, DateTime):
58	
59	```xml
60	<ui:AddQueueItem
61	    QueueType="InvoiceProcessing"
62	    Priority="High"
63	    Reference="INV-2024-002"
64	    xmlns:ui="clr-namespace:UiPath.Core.Activities;assembly=UiPath.System.Activities"
65	    xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
66	  <ui:AddQueueItem.ItemInformation>
67	    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="InvoiceNumber">"INV-2024-002"</InArgument>
68	    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Double" x:Key="Amount">1500.0</InArgument>
69	    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" x:Key="Approved">True</InArgument>
70	    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="s:DateTime" x:Key="InvoiceDate">[DateTime.Today]</InArgument>
71	  </ui:AddQueueItem.ItemInformation>
72	</ui:AddQueueItem>
73	```
74	
75	Each entry's `x:TypeArguments` determines how Orchestrator serializes the field in the item's `SpecificContent`: typed numbers and booleans are preserved as JSON numbers/booleans, and `DateTime` values serialize as ISO-8601 strings. Use `s:DateTime` (not `x:DateTime`) for `DateTime` — see [Postpone Transaction Item](PostponeTransactionItem.md) for the underlying reason.
76	
77	## Common Runtime Errors
78	
79	| Error | Cause | Fix |
80	|-------|-------|-----|
81	| `OrchestratorHttpException: 404 Not Found — "<QueueName>" does not exist. Error code: 1002` | The queue named in `QueueType` does not exist in the resolved Orchestrator folder. The activity does **not** auto-create queues. | Create the queue in Orchestrator first, or confirm that `FolderPath` (explicit or robot-inherited) points to the folder containing the queue. |
82	| `OrchestratorHttpException: 409 Conflict — Reference already exists` | A queue item with the same `Reference` already exists and the queue is configured for **Unique References**. | Either use a unique reference for each item or disable Unique References on the queue in Orchestrator. |
83	| `OrchestratorHttpException: 401 Unauthorized` | The robot is not connected to Orchestrator, or its credentials no longer have permission to write to the queue. | Re-authenticate the robot and verify it has the **Queues: Edit** role on the folder. |
84	
85	## Notes
86	
87	- Requires an active Orchestrator connection. The robot must be connected to Orchestrator at runtime.
88	- The item is created with status **New**. To immediately begin processing, use **Add Transaction Item** instead.
89	- `FolderPath` is an advanced/hidden property that overrides the Orchestrator folder resolved from the robot context.
90	- `ServiceBaseAddress` is deprecated and ignored.
91

        </InArgument>
      </Assign.Value>
    </Assign>

    <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Combine Text">
      <Assign.To>
        <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">

        </OutArgument>

    <!-- Default category and priority -->
    <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Set Default Category">

        </InArgument>
      </Assign.Value>
    </Assign>

    <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Set Default Priority">
      <Assign.To>
        <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="out_Priority" />
        </OutArgument>
      </Assign.To>
      <Assign.Value>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""Normal"" />
        </InArgument>
      </Assign.Value>
    </Assign>

    <!-- URGENT: outage, down, broken, critical, urgent, emergency, not working -->
    <If DisplayName="Check Urgent Keywords">
      <If.Condition>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="combinedText.Contains("outage") OrElse combinedText.Contains("down") OrElse combinedText.Contains("critical") OrElse combinedText.Contains("urgent") OrElse combinedText.Contains("emergency") OrElse combinedText.Contains("not working") OrElse combinedText.Contains("broken")" />
        </InArgument>
      </If.Condition>
      <If.Then>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Then">
          <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Set Urgent Category">
            <Assign.To>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="out_Category" />
              </OutArgument>
            </Assign.To>
            <Assign.Value>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""Urgent"" />
              </InArgument>
            </Assign.Value>
          </Assign>
          <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Set High Priority">
            <Assign.To>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="out_Priority" />
              </OutArgument>
            </Assign.To>
            <Assign.Value>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""High"" />
              </InArgument>
            </Assign.Value>
          </Assign>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Then>
      <If.Else>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Else">
          <!-- BILLING: invoice, payment, charge, refund, billing, subscription -->
          <If DisplayName="Check Billing Keywords">
            <If.Condition>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="combinedText.Contains("invoice") OrElse combinedText.Contains("payment") OrElse combinedText.Contains("charge") OrElse combinedText.Contains("refund") OrElse combinedText.Contains("billing") OrElse combinedText.Contains("subscription")" />
              </InArgument>
            </If.Condition>
            <If.Then>
              <Sequence DisplayName="Then">
                <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Set Billing Category">
                  <Assign.To>
                    <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                      <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="out_Category" />
                    </OutArgument>
                  </Assign.To>
                  <Assign.Value>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""Billing"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </Assign.Value>
                </Assign>
              </Sequence>
            </If.Then>
            <If.Else>
              <Sequence DisplayName="Else">
                <!-- TECHNICAL: error, bug, crash, install, setup, configure, login, password, access -->
                <If DisplayName="Check Technical Keywords">
                  <If.Condition>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="combinedText.Contains("error") OrElse combinedText.Contains("bug") OrElse combinedText.Contains("crash") OrElse combinedText.Contains("install") OrElse combinedText.Contains("setup") OrElse combinedText.Contains("configure") OrElse combinedText.Contains("login") OrElse combinedText.Contains("password") OrElse combinedText.Contains("access")" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </If.Condition>
                  <If.Then>
                    <Sequence DisplayName="Then">
                      <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Set Technical Category">
                        <Assign.To>
                          <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                            <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="out_Category" />
                          </OutArgument>
                        </Assign.To>
                        <Assign.Value>
                          <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                            <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""Technical"" />
                          </InArgument>
                        </Assign.Value>
                      </Assign>
                    </Sequence>
                  </If.Then>
                </If>
              </Sequence>
            </If.Else>
          </If>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Else>
    </If>

    <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Triage Result">
      <ui:LogMessage.Message>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Triage: Subject=[{in_Subject}] → Category={out_Category}, Priority={out_Priority}"" />
        </InArgument>
      </ui:LogMessage.Message>
    </ui:LogMessage>

  </Sequence>
</Activity>

<Activity mc:Ignorable="sap sap2010" x:Class="Workflows_ProcessEmail"
  mva:VisualBasic.Settings="{x:Null}"
  xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities"
  xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
  xmlns:mva="clr-namespace:Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities;assembly=System.Activities"
  xmlns:sap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sap2010="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2010/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:scg="clr-namespace:System.Collections.Generic;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:sco="clr-namespace:System.Collections.ObjectModel;assembly=mscorlib"
  xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities"
  xmlns:umae="clr-namespace:UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:umame="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Enums;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:usau="clr-namespace:UiPath.Shared.Activities.Utils;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <x:Members>
    <x:Property Name="in_From" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_Subject" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_Body" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_Category" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_Priority" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_SmtpServer" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_SmtpPort" Type="InArgument(x:Int32)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_SmtpEmail" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_SmtpPassword" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <x:Property Name="in_QueueName" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
  </x:Members>
  <TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="x:String">
      <x:String>System.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Activities.Statements</x:String>
      <x:String>Microsoft.VisualBasic</x:String>
      <x:String>Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>System</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections.Generic</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Linq</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail.SMTP.Activities</x:String>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
  <TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="AssemblyReference">
      <AssemblyReference>System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>Microsoft.VisualBasic</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Private.CoreLib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>mscorlib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Linq</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.Mail.Activities</AssemblyReference>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
  <Sequence DisplayName="Process Email" sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="Sequence_1">
    <Sequence.Variables>
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="autoReplyBody" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="queuePriority" Default=""Normal"" />
    </Sequence.Variables>

    <!-- Step 1: Build acknowledgment auto-reply body -->
    <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Build Auto-Reply Body">
      <Assign.To>
        <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="autoReplyBody" />
        </OutArgument>
      </Assign.To>
      <Assign.Value>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""Dear Customer," & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Thank you for reaching out to our support team. We have received your email and it has been categorized as: " & in_Category & " (Priority: " & in_Priority & ")." & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Our team will review your request and respond as soon as possible." & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Best regards," & Environment.NewLine & "Support Team"" />
        </InArgument>
      </Assign.Value>
    </Assign>

    <!-- Step 2: Map category priority to queue priority -->
    <If DisplayName="Map Priority to Queue Priority">
      <If.Condition>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="in_Priority = "High"" />
        </InArgument>
      </If.Condition>
      <If.Then>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Then">
          <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Set High Queue Priority">
            <Assign.To>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="queuePriority" />
              </OutArgument>
            </Assign.To>
            <Assign.Value>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""High"" />
              </InArgument>
            </Assign.Value>
          </Assign>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Then>
    </If>

    <!-- Step 3: Send acknowledgment auto-reply via SMTP -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Send Auto-Reply">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">
          <ui:SendMail
            Server="[in_SmtpServer]"
            Port="[in_SmtpPort]"
            Email="[in_SmtpEmail]"
            Password="[in_SmtpPassword]"
            To="[in_From]"
            Subject="["Re: " & in_Subject]"
            Body="[autoReplyBody]"
            IsBodyHtml="False"
            EnableSSL="True"
            SecureConnection="Auto"
            UseISConnection="False"
            DisplayName="Send Acknowledgment Reply">
            <ui:SendMail.AttachmentsBackup>
              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode" StoredValue="{x:Null}">
                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
              </usau:BackupSlot>
            </ui:SendMail.AttachmentsBackup>
            <ui:SendMail.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails" StoredValue="{x:Null}">
                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
              </usau:BackupSlot>
            </ui:SendMail.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
            <ui:SendMail.Files>
              <scg:List x:TypeArguments="InArgument(x:String)" Capacity="0" />
            </ui:SendMail.Files>
          </ui:SendMail>
          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Reply Sent">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Auto-reply sent to {in_From} for subject: {in_Subject}"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>
        </Sequence>
      </TryCatch.Try>
      <TryCatch.Catches>
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
          <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
            <ActivityAction.Argument>
              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log Reply Failed">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Failed to send auto-reply to {in_From}: {ex.Message}"" />
                  </InArgument>
                </ui:LogMessage.Message>
              </ui:LogMessage>
            </Sequence>
          </ActivityAction>
        </Catch>
      </TryCatch.Catches>
    </TryCatch>

    <!-- Step 4: Add email to Orchestrator queue for agent follow-up -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Add to Orchestrator Queue">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">
          <ui:AddQueueItem
            QueueType="[in_QueueName]"
            Priority="[DirectCast(System.Enum.Parse(GetType(UiPath.Core.QueueItemPriority), queuePriority), UiPath.Core.QueueItemPriority)]"
            Reference="[in_From & "|" & DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss")]"
            DisplayName="Add Email to Queue">
            <ui:AddQueueItem.ItemInformation>
              <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="x:String, InArgument" />
            </ui:AddQueueItem.ItemInformation>
            <ui:AddQueueItem.ItemInformationCollection>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="scg:Dictionary(x:String, x:Object)">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="scg:Dictionary(x:String, x:Object)" ExpressionText="New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"From", in_From}, {"Subject", in_Subject}, {"Category", in_Category}, {"Priority", in_Priority}, {"ReceivedAt", DateTime.Now.ToString()}}" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:AddQueueItem.ItemInformationCollection>
          </ui:AddQueueItem>
          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Queue Item Added">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Email added to queue '{in_QueueName}': From={in_From}, Category={in_Category}, Priority={in_Priority}"" />
              </InArgument>

          </ui:LogMessage>
        </Sequence>
      </TryCatch.Try>
      <TryCatch.Catches>
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
          <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
            <ActivityAction.Argument>
              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log Queue Add Failed">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Failed to add email to Orchestrator queue (continuing): {ex.Message}"" />
                  </InArgument>
                </ui:LogMessage.Message>
              </ui:LogMessage>
            </Sequence>
          </ActivityAction>
        </Catch>
      </TryCatch.Catches>
    </TryCatch>

  </Sequence>
</Activity>

<Activity mc:Ignorable="sap sap2010" x:Class="Main"
  mva:VisualBasic.Settings="{x:Null}"
  xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities"
  xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
  xmlns:mva="clr-namespace:Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities;assembly=System.Activities"
  xmlns:sap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sap2010="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2010/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:scg="clr-namespace:System.Collections.Generic;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:sco="clr-namespace:System.Collections.ObjectModel;assembly=mscorlib"
  xmlns:smm="clr-namespace:System.Net.Mail;assembly=System.Net.Mail"
  xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities"
  xmlns:umae="clr-namespace:UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:usau="clr-namespace:UiPath.Shared.Activities.Utils;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="x:String">
      <x:String>System.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Activities.Statements</x:String>
      <x:String>Microsoft.VisualBasic</x:String>
      <x:String>Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>System</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections.Generic</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Linq</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Net.Mail</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail.IMAP.Activities</x:String>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
  <TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="AssemblyReference">
      <AssemblyReference>System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>Microsoft.VisualBasic</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Private.CoreLib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>mscorlib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Linq</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Net.Mail</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.Mail.Activities</AssemblyReference>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
  <Sequence DisplayName="Main Sequence" sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="Sequence_1">
    <Sequence.Variables>
      <!-- IMAP connection settings — override these with Orchestrator Assets in production -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="imapServer" Default=""imap.yourdomain.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="imapPort" Default="993" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="supportEmail" Default=""support@yourdomain.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailPassword" Default=""YOUR_EMAIL_PASSWORD"" />
      <!-- SMTP settings for sending auto-replies -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="smtpServer" Default=""smtp.yourdomain.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="smtpPort" Default="587" />
      <!-- Orchestrator queue for routing -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="queueName" Default=""SupportEmailQueue"" />
      <!-- Retrieved emails and loop variables -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="scg:List(smm:MailMessage)" Name="emailMessages" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailCategory" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailPriority" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="processedCount" Default="0" />
    </Sequence.Variables>

    <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Start">
      <ui:LogMessage.Message>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"EmailSupportAutomation started at {DateTime.Now}"" />
        </InArgument>
      </ui:LogMessage.Message>
    </ui:LogMessage>

    <!-- Step 1: Read unread emails from IMAP inbox -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Read Support Emails">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">
          <ui:GetIMAPMailMessages
            Server="[imapServer]"
            Port="[imapPort]"
            Email="[supportEmail]"
            Password="[emailPassword]"
            Messages="[emailMessages]"
            MailFolder="Inbox"
            OnlyUnreadMessages="True"
            Top="50"
            MarkAsRead="True"
            EnableSSL="True"
            SecureConnection="Auto"
            UseISConnection="False"
            DisplayName="Get Unread Support Emails">
            <ui:GetIMAPMailMessages.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails" StoredValue="{x:Null}">
                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
              </usau:BackupSlot>
            </ui:GetIMAPMailMessages.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
          </ui:GetIMAPMailMessages>

          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Emails Retrieved">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Retrieved {If(emailMessages IsNot Nothing, emailMessages.Count, 0)} unread email(s) from inbox"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>
        </Sequence>
      </TryCatch.Try>
      <TryCatch.Catches>
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
          <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
            <ActivityAction.Argument>
              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Error" DisplayName="Log Email Read Error">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Failed to read emails from mailbox: {ex.Message}"" />
                  </InArgument>
                </ui:LogMessage.Message>
              </ui:LogMessage>
              <Throw DisplayName="Rethrow as SystemException">
                <Throw.Exception>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" ExpressionText="New Exception("Unable to connect to mailbox. Check IMAP settings and credentials.", ex)" />
                  </InArgument>
                </Throw.Exception>
              </Throw>
            </Sequence>
          </ActivityAction>
        </Catch>
      </TryCatch.Catches>
    </TryCatch>

    <!-- Step 2: Process each email only if we got a list back -->
    <If DisplayName="Check Emails Exist">
      <If.Condition>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="emailMessages IsNot Nothing AndAlso emailMessages.Count > 0" />
        </InArgument>
      </If.Condition>
      <If.Then>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Then">
          <ui:ForEach x:TypeArguments="smm:MailMessage" DisplayName="For Each Email">
            <ui:ForEach.Values>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="sc:IEnumerable" xmlns:sc="clr-namespace:System.Collections;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="sc:IEnumerable" ExpressionText="emailMessages" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:ForEach.Values>
            <ui:ForEach.Body>
              <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="smm:MailMessage">
                <ActivityAction.Argument>
                  <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="smm:MailMessage" Name="email" />

<Activity mc:Ignorable="sap sap2010" x:Class="Main"
  mva:VisualBasic.Settings="{x:Null}"
  xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities"
  xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
  xmlns:mva="clr-namespace:Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities;assembly=System.Activities"
  xmlns:sap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sap2010="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2010/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:scg="clr-namespace:System.Collections.Generic;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:sco="clr-namespace:System.Collections.ObjectModel;assembly=mscorlib"
  xmlns:sc="clr-namespace:System.Collections;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities"
  xmlns:umae="clr-namespace:UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:usau="clr-namespace:UiPath.Shared.Activities.Utils;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="x:String">
      <x:String>System.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Activities.Statements</x:String>
      <x:String>Microsoft.VisualBasic</x:String>
      <x:String>Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>System</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections.Generic</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Linq</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail.IMAP.Activities</x:String>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
  <TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="AssemblyReference">
      <AssemblyReference>System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>Microsoft.VisualBasic</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Private.CoreLib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>mscorlib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Linq</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.Mail.Activities</AssemblyReference>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
  <Sequence DisplayName="Main Sequence" sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="Sequence_1">
    <Sequence.Variables>
      <!-- IMAP connection settings — override these with Orchestrator Assets in production -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="imapServer" Default=""imap.yourdomain.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="imapPort" Default="993" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="supportEmail" Default=""support@yourdomain.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailPassword" Default=""YOUR_EMAIL_PASSWORD"" />
      <!-- SMTP settings for sending auto-replies -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="smtpServer" Default=""smtp.yourdomain.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="smtpPort" Default="587" />
      <!-- Orchestrator queue for routing -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="queueName" Default=""SupportEmailQueue"" />
      <!-- Retrieved emails: Object holds List(Of UiPathMailMessage) returned by GetIMAPMailMessages -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Object" Name="emailMessages" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailCategory" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailPriority" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="processedCount" Default="0" />
    </Sequence.Variables>

    <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Start">
      <ui:LogMessage.Message>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"EmailSupportAutomation started at {DateTime.Now}"" />
        </InArgument>
      </ui:LogMessage.Message>
    </ui:LogMessage>

    <!-- Step 1: Read unread emails from IMAP inbox -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Read Support Emails">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">
          <ui:GetIMAPMailMessages
            Server="[imapServer]"
            Port="[imapPort]"
            Email="[supportEmail]"
            Password="[emailPassword]"
            Messages="[emailMessages]"
            MailFolder="Inbox"
            OnlyUnreadMessages="True"
            Top="50"
            MarkAsRead="True"
            EnableSSL="True"
            SecureConnection="Auto"
            UseISConnection="False"
            DisplayName="Get Unread Support Emails">
            <ui:GetIMAPMailMessages.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails" StoredValue="{x:Null}">
                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
              </usau:BackupSlot>
            </ui:GetIMAPMailMessages.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
          </ui:GetIMAPMailMessages>

          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Emails Retrieved">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Retrieved {If(emailMessages IsNot Nothing, DirectCast(emailMessages, IList).Count, 0)} unread email(s) from inbox"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>
        </Sequence>
      </TryCatch.Try>
      <TryCatch.Catches>
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
          <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
            <ActivityAction.Argument>
              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Error" DisplayName="Log Email Read Error">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Failed to read emails from mailbox: {ex.Message}"" />
                  </InArgument>
                </ui:LogMessage.Message>
              </ui:LogMessage>
              <Throw DisplayName="Rethrow as SystemException">
                <Throw.Exception>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" ExpressionText="New Exception("Unable to connect to mailbox. Check IMAP settings and credentials.", ex)" />
                  </InArgument>
                </Throw.Exception>
              </Throw>
            </Sequence>
          </ActivityAction>
        </Catch>
      </TryCatch.Catches>
    </TryCatch>

    <!-- Step 2: Process each email only if we got a list back -->
    <If DisplayName="Check Emails Exist">
      <If.Condition>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="emailMessages IsNot Nothing AndAlso DirectCast(emailMessages, IList).Count > 0" />
        </InArgument>
      </If.Condition>
      <If.Then>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Then">
          <!-- Iterate over messages as Object — properties accessed via late binding at runtime -->
          <ui:ForEach x:TypeArguments="x:Object" DisplayName="For Each Email">
            <ui:ForEach.Values>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="sc:IEnumerable">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="sc:IEnumerable" ExpressionText="DirectCast(emailMessages, IEnumerable)" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:ForEach.Values>
            <ui:ForEach.Body>
              <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <ActivityAction.Argument>
                  <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object" Name="email" />
                </ActivityAction.Argument>
                <Sequence DisplayName="Body">
                  <Sequence.Variables>
                    <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="senderAddress" Default="""" />
                    <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailSubject" Default="""" />
                    <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="emailBody" Default="""" />
                  </Sequence.Variables>

                  <!-- Extract fields via CallOperationActivity / Assign with late binding -->
                  <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Get Sender Address">
                    <Assign.To>
                      <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="senderAddress" />
                      </OutArgument>
                    </Assign.To>
                    <Assign.Value>
                      <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="If(email IsNot Nothing AndAlso email.From IsNot Nothing, email.From.Address, "unknown@unknown.com")" />
                      </InArgument>
                    </Assign.Value>
                  </Assign>

                  <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Get Subject">
                    <Assign.To>
                      <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailSubject" />
                      </OutArgument>
                    </Assign.To>
                    <Assign.Value>
                      <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="If(email IsNot Nothing AndAlso email.Subject IsNot Nothing, CStr(email.Subject), "(no subject)")" />
                      </InArgument>
                    </Assign.Value>
                  </Assign>

                  <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Get Body">
                    <Assign.To>
                      <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailBody" />
                      </OutArgument>
                    </Assign.To>
                    <Assign.Value>
                      <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="If(email IsNot Nothing AndAlso email.Body IsNot Nothing, CStr(email.Body), "")" />
                      </InArgument>
                    </Assign.Value>
                  </Assign>

                  <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Processing Email">
                    <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                      <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"Processing email from {senderAddress}: {emailSubject}"" />
                      </InArgument>
                    </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  </ui:LogMessage>

                  <!-- Sub-workflow: Triage (categorize) the email -->
                  <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile WorkflowFileName="Workflows\TriageEmail.xaml" DisplayName="Triage Email">
                    <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_Subject" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailSubject" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_Body" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailBody" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <OutArgument x:Key="out_Category" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailCategory" />
                      </OutArgument>
                      <OutArgument x:Key="out_Priority" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailPriority" />
                      </OutArgument>
                    </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                  </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile>

                  <!-- Sub-workflow: Process (auto-reply + queue + log) -->
                  <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile WorkflowFileName="Workflows\ProcessEmail.xaml" DisplayName="Process Email">
                    <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_From" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="senderAddress" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_Subject" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailSubject" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_Body" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailBody" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_Category" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailCategory" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_Priority" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailPriority" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_SmtpServer" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="smtpServer" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_SmtpPort" x:TypeArguments="x:Int32">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" ExpressionText="smtpPort" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_SmtpEmail" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="supportEmail" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_SmtpPassword" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="emailPassword" />
                      </InArgument>
                      <InArgument x:Key="in_QueueName" x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="queueName" />
                      </InArgument>
                    </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                  </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile>

                  <!-- Increment processed counter -->
                  <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" DisplayName="Increment Counter">
                    <Assign.To>
                      <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32">
                        <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" ExpressionText="processedCount" />
                      </OutArgument>
                    </Assign.To>
                    <Assign.Value>
                      <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32">
                        <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" ExpressionText="processedCount + 1" />
                      </InArgument>
                    </Assign.Value>
                  </Assign>

                </Sequence>
              </ActivityAction>
            </ui:ForEach.Body>
          </ui:ForEach>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Then>
      <If.Else>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Else">
          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log No Emails">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""No unread emails found in inbox. Nothing to process."" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Else>
    </If>

    <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log Completion">
      <ui:LogMessage.Message>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"EmailSupportAutomation completed. Processed {processedCount} email(s)."" />
        </InArgument>
      </ui:LogMessage.Message>
    </ui:LogMessage>

  </Sequence>
</Activity>

23	| Language | Language | `NetLanguage` | `NetLanguage.VBNet` | The programming language of the code snippet (`VBNet` or `CSharp`). |
24	| Arguments | Arguments | `Dictionary<string, Argument>` | — | Named input/output argument bindings that make workflow variables available inside the code and allow returning values back to the workflow. |

result = doubled"

53	```

` for line breaks. This is the preferred form for generated snippets and portable tooling output. `Code` is a plain `string` property, so validate any child-element string serialization in the target consumer before relying on it.

| TriageEmail.xaml | Classifies email via lowercase keyword matching on subject+body | Assign, nested If chains, LogMessage |
| ProcessEmail.xaml | Builds acknowledgment body, sends SMTP reply, inserts Orchestrator queue item | Assign, If, SendMail, AddQueueItem, TryCatch, LogMessage |

## Architecture

- **Pattern**: Main orchestrates two sequential sub-workflow invocations per email (Triage → Process)
- **Data flow**: IMAP messages returned as `Object`; fields extracted by reflection via `InvokeCode`; typed strings passed as arguments to sub-workflows
- **Execution flow**: Log start → GetIMAPMailMessages (TryCatch, fatal on failure) → If emails exist → ForEach email → extract fields → InvokeWorkflowFile TriageEmail → InvokeWorkflowFile ProcessEmail → increment counter → Log completion
- **Triage categories**: `Urgent` (High priority), `Billing` (Normal priority), `Technical` (Normal priority), `General` (default, Normal priority)
- **Queue item fields**: `From`, `Subject`, `Category`, `Priority`, `ReceivedAt`; reference key: `{sender}|{yyyyMMddHHmmss}`
- **External integrations**: IMAP inbox (inbound read), SMTP (outbound auto-reply), UiPath Orchestrator Queues (routing)
- **Config**: All connection settings (IMAP server/port/credentials, SMTP server/port, queue name) are local variables in Main.xaml — comments note these should be replaced with Orchestrator Assets in production

```vb
' Sub-workflow with typed in/out arguments — e.g., TriageEmail.xaml pattern
' Arguments declared as x:Members at the top of the Activity element:
'   in_Subject  InArgument(String)
'   in_Body     InArgument(String)
'   out_Category OutArgument(String)
'   out_Priority OutArgument(String)
'
' Invoked from Main via InvokeWorkflowFile:
'   WorkflowFileName="Workflows\TriageEmail.xaml"
'   InArgument x:Key="in_Subject" → VisualBasicValue ExpressionText="emailSubject"
'   OutArgument x:Key="out_Category" → VisualBasicReference ExpressionText="emailCategory"
```

```vb
' External I/O error handling pattern (TryCatch in XAML)
' Fatal path (e.g., IMAP): log Error → Throw New Exception("...", ex)
' Non-fatal path (e.g., SMTP, queue): log Warn, no rethrow — execution continues to next step
'
' Interpolated log messages use VB string interpolation:
'   ExpressionText="$""Email added to queue '{in_QueueName}': From={in_From}"""
```

3	Capability index for building new flows (greenfield) and editing existing flows (brownfield). Author owns everything that happens on disk, locally, without `uip login`. Authoring journeys terminate at `validate` + `format`; from there, hand off to [operate/CAPABILITY.md](../operate/CAPABILITY.md) to publish, run, or debug.

5	> **Where you came from / where to go next.** Author is upstream of Operate (build the flow → ship it) and upstream of Diagnose only via Operate (build → run → diagnose). Publish/run/lifecycle lives in [operate/CAPABILITY.md](../operate/CAPABILITY.md); fault triage lives in [diagnose/CAPABILITY.md](../diagnose/CAPABILITY.md).
6	>
7	> **Inherits universal rules from [SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md)** — `--output json` + prefer `--output-filter` for extraction, no `flow debug` without consent, resource discovery order, never invoke other skills automatically, dropdown question pattern, solution layout, **plain-English narration + granular progress list (opt-in — silent by default; engage when the user asks for verbosity)**. The rules below are author-scoped and apply on top.
8	
9	## When to use this capability
10	
11	- Create a new Flow project with `uip maestro flow init`
12	- Edit a `.flow` file — adding nodes, edges, or logic
13	- Explore available node types via the registry
14	- Validate a Flow file locally
15	- Manage variables, subflows, expressions, and output wiring
16	- Apply Node ownership — who authors the node (see § below)
17	- Configure connector, connector-trigger, or managed HTTP nodes; scaffold inline-agent projects
18	- Plan a complex flow before building
19	
20	## Node ownership — who authors the node
21	
22	Every node in a `.flow` file has exactly one author. The validator enforces this.
23	
24	**User-owned nodes (Edit / Write directly):**
25	
26	| Category | Node types |
27	| --- | --- |
28	| Triggers | `core.trigger.manual`, `core.trigger.scheduled` |
29	| Control flow | `core.logic.decision`, `core.logic.switch`, `core.logic.loop`, `core.logic.merge`, `core.control.end`, `core.logic.terminate`, `core.subflow` |
30	| Logic | `core.action.script`, `core.action.transform`, `core.logic.delay`, `core.logic.mock` |
31	| Human-in-the-loop | `uipath.human-in-the-loop.quick-form` (inline form), `uipath.human-in-the-loop.coded-action-app` (app-based) |
32	| Patterns | `uipath.pattern.batch-transform`, `uipath.pattern.deep-rag` |
33	| Agents | `uipath.agent.autonomous` (inline; after `uip agent init --inline-in-flow`) |
34	| Resource nodes | `uipath.core.rpa-workflow.*`, `uipath.core.agent.*`, `uipath.core.flow.*`, `uipath.core.agentic-process.*`, `uipath.core.api-workflow.*`, `uipath.core.human-task.*` |
35	| Queue | `core.action.queue.create`, `core.action.queue.create-and-wait` |
36	
37	**CLI-owned nodes (`uip maestro flow node add` + `uip maestro flow node configure`):**
38	
39	| Category | Node types | Why |
40	| --- | --- | --- |
41	| Connector activities | `uipath.connector.<key>.<op>` | `inputs.detail` is a `=jsonString:essentialConfiguration` envelope. Validate rejects hand-authored shapes. |
42	| Connector triggers | `uipath.connector.trigger.<key>.<trigger>` | Same envelope + product-managed `bindings_v2.json` derivation. |
43	| Wait for events (mid-flow) | `uipath.connector.event.<key>.<event>` | Same envelope and event metadata as a trigger, but placed mid-flow (has an `input` port) instead of as the start node. See [connector-trigger/impl.md — Wait for events](references/plugins/connector-trigger/impl.md#wait-for-events-uipathconnectoreventkeyevent). |
44	| Managed HTTP | `core.action.http.v2` | Same envelope. |
45	
46	For CLI-owned nodes:
47	
48	- Use `uip maestro flow node add` to insert the node and copy the definition into `definitions[]`.
49	- Use `uip maestro flow node configure --detail '{...}'` to populate `inputs.detail` and `bindings[]`.
50	- Subsequent edits to `inputs.detail` are also CLI-only — re-run `node configure` (it's a full rebuild; see [connector/impl.md](references/plugins/connector/impl.md)).
51	- You may still `Edit` the node's `display.label`, edges, layout, and outputs — those are not part of the envelope.
52	
53	If you find yourself hand-writing `inputs.detail`, a `=jsonString:` blob, or `bindings[]` entries for a connector node — stop. Use the CLI.
54	
55	## Critical rules
56	
57	1. **Always validate node types against the registry before building.** Use `registry search`/`list` for discovery and `registry get` for detailed metadata and definitions.
58	2. **ALWAYS follow the relevant plugin in [plugins/](references/plugins/) for every node type.** Each plugin has a `planning.md` (when to use, selection heuristics, ports) and `impl.md` (registry validation, JSON structure, CLI commands, configuration, debug). For connector nodes, the [connector](references/plugins/connector/impl.md) plugin covers connection binding, enriched metadata, and field resolution — required before building. Without this, node configuration will be wrong — errors that `flow validate` does not catch.
59	3. **Read the relevant Integration Service reference doc before any `uip is ...` call.** Two non-overlapping contracts:
60	   - **Read [/uipath:uipath-platform — connections.md](../../../uipath-platform/references/integration-service/connections.md) before any `uip is connections ...` call.** Applies to every connector activity, connector trigger, and managed HTTP node in connected mode. Single source of truth for command syntax, selection (including the personal-workspace auto-select rule), folder scoping, BYOA filtering, empty-result recovery, and ping verification. **If no healthy connection exists after following its recovery flow, STOP** and surface it in **Open Questions** during planning.
61	   - **Read [/uipath:uipath-platform — resources.md](../../../uipath-platform/references/integration-service/resources.md) before any `uip is resources run ...` call.** Applies to every reference-field lookup (Slack user IDs, Jira project keys, Outlook folder IDs, etc.). Single source of truth for the `Data.Pagination.HasMore` / `NextPageToken` contract and the `--query "nextPage=<token>"` loop. **Complete the pagination loop before reporting not-found** — do NOT abandon mid-loop to try alternative endpoints, `where=` filters the connector may not support, or asking the user. Plugin files cover node-specific configuration that follows connection binding: [connector/impl.md](references/plugins/connector/impl.md), [connector-trigger/impl.md](references/plugins/connector-trigger/impl.md), [http/impl-connector.md](references/plugins/http/impl-connector.md).
62	4. **Edit `<ProjectName>.flow` only** — other generated files (`bindings_v2.json`, `entry-points.json`, `operate.json`, `package-descriptor.json`) are managed by the CLI and may be overwritten. To declare flow inputs/outputs, add variables in the `.flow` file (see [shared/file-format.md](../shared/file-format.md)).
63	5. **`targetPort` is required on every edge** — `validate` rejects edges without it.
64	6. **Every node type needs a `definitions` entry** — copy from `uip maestro flow registry get <node-type>` output. Never hand-write definitions. The definition is the sole source for BPMN type (`model.type`), serviceType, event definitions, and binding/context templates — none of that belongs on the instance.
65	7. **Script nodes must `return` an object** — `return { key: value }`, not a bare scalar.
66	8. **Validate once at the end** — run `uip maestro flow validate` only after all nodes, edges, and configuration are complete. Do not validate after each individual node add or edit — intermediate states are expected to be invalid.
67	9. **Manage variables with `Edit` against the `.flow` file** — there are no CLI commands for variable management. Use `Edit` to add/remove/update entries in the `variables` section of the `.flow` file. See [shared/variables-and-expressions.md](../shared/variables-and-expressions.md).
68	10. **Every `out` variable must be mapped on every reachable End node** — missing output mappings cause runtime errors. See [shared/variables-and-expressions.md](../shared/variables-and-expressions.md).
69	11. **`=js:` prefix is REQUIRED on every `$vars`/`$metadata`/`$self` reference in a value field** — not on condition expressions (decision, switch, HTTP branch), which are auto-evaluated as JS. Without it, the BPMN runtime sees a literal string and `flow validate` fails with MST-9107. See [shared/node-output-wiring.md](../shared/node-output-wiring.md) for the canonical rule and per-node-type field reference, and [shared/variables-and-expressions.md](../shared/variables-and-expressions.md) for the expression system.
70	12. **Always run `flow format` after edits** — `uip maestro flow format <ProjectName>.flow` is the canonical layout step. Format arranges nodes horizontally, sets each node's `size` by its canvas shape (inline agents → 288×96, containers → 560×320, everything else → 96×96), and recurses into subflows (`subflows[<id>].layout`). Skipping format is the most common cause of misshapen nodes in Studio Web.
71	13. **Don't hand-write `layout.nodes` or `subflows[<id>].layout`** — these are owned by `flow format`. When authoring nodes, any placeholder `position` is fine (e.g. `{ x: 0, y: 0 }`); format rewrites it on save. Sticky notes (`type: "stickyNote"`) are the one exception — format preserves their custom size and position. See [shared/file-format.md — Layout](../shared/file-format.md#layout).
72	14. **Every data-producing node MUST have a matching `variables.nodes[]` entry — this is what makes `$vars.<sourceNodeId>.output` resolve.** The BPMN emitter walks `variables.nodes[]` to write the process-level `<uipath:inputOutput>` declarations the runtime needs. The instance `outputs` block is **only** consumed by BPMN serialization on end-style nodes (to map workflow-level `out` variables); for action / trigger nodes it is documentation, not behavior. Skipping `variables.nodes[]` produces a flow that passes `flow validate` but resolves `$vars.<sourceNodeId>.output` to `undefined` at runtime (MST-9972). **Always run `uip maestro flow format` after structural edits — it regenerates `variables.nodes[]` from `nodes[]` + `definitions[]`** (matching what `uip maestro flow node add` and the canvas save path do), so this becomes self-healing as long as you `format`. See [shared/file-format.md — Node outputs](../shared/file-format.md#node-outputs).
73	15. **Node instances have no `model` block** — BPMN type, serviceType, version, event definitions, and binding/context templates live in the node's **definition** (in the top-level `definitions[]` array, copied verbatim from `registry get`). The runtime hydrates these from the definition at serialization time. Instance-specific identity fields live under `inputs`: `entryPointId`, `isDefaultEntryPoint` (triggers), `color`/`content` (sticky notes), and `source` (every inline-agent-related node — both `uipath.agent.autonomous` and every attached `uipath.agent.resource.*` node use `inputs.source = <UUID>`; their definitions declare `model.source: true` and flow-core hoists onto the instance).

112	## Anti-patterns
113	
114	- **Prefer running `uip maestro flow init` from inside the solution you named** — run outside one it auto-scaffolds `<Project>Solution/`, but the auto name won't match your chosen solution name. Never pass `--skip-solution-registration` for a project you intend to upload (it leaves a bare single-nested layout). See [SKILL.md rule #6](../../SKILL.md#critical-rules-universal) for the required double-nested `<Solution>/<Project>/<Project>.flow` layout and the self-check.
115	- **Never guess node schemas** — use `registry get` for all node types. Guessed port names or input fields cause silent wiring failures.
116	- **Never skip capability discovery for connector nodes** — run `registry search` to confirm the connector exists and what operations it supports before building. See [connector/planning.md](references/plugins/connector/planning.md). Skipping this is the #1 cause of designing around a connector that doesn't exist or an operation it doesn't support.
117	- **Never replace a registered connector operation with `core.logic.mock` because configuration cannot run** — if `registry search` / `registry get` finds `uipath.connector.<connector-key>.<operation>`, add that real connector node via `uip maestro flow node add`. Missing live connections, missing tenant access, or prompts that ask you to only plan `--detail` mean: run `node add`, write the planned `--detail` payload to a sidecar file (e.g. `<nodeId>.detail.json`), and surface "configure pending" as an Open Question. **Do not leave a partial `inputs.detail` on the node** — the validator rejects hand-authored envelopes, and the node will not pass `flow validate` until `node configure` is run. Studio Web and reviewers need the real connector key in the `.flow`; the agent must report this explicitly rather than letting the user discover it via a later validation failure. See [§ Node ownership](#node-ownership--who-authors-the-node) and [connector/impl.md — No-Live-Tenant / Planned Configuration](references/plugins/connector/impl.md#no-live-tenant--planned-configuration).
118	- **Never edit `content/*.bpmn`** — it is auto-generated from the `.flow` file and will be overwritten.
119	- **Never use `core.logic.mock` when the resource is in the same solution** — use `--local` discovery instead. Mock placeholders are only for resources that are not in the current solution and not yet published.
120	- **Never hand-write `definitions` entries** — always copy from registry output. Hand-written definitions have wrong port schemas and cause validation failures.
121	- **Never put any `model` block on node instances** — BPMN type, serviceType, event definition, binding templates, and context templates all live in the node's **definition** (copied verbatim from `registry get` into `definitions[]`). Instances carry only per-instance data: `inputs`, `outputs`, `display`. Identity fields like `entryPointId` / `isDefaultEntryPoint` (triggers) and `color` / `content` (sticky notes) live under `inputs`. This applies to every inline-agent-related node too: `uipath.agent.autonomous` plus every attached `uipath.agent.resource.*` node (tool, escalation, context) carries source identity at `inputs.source = <UUID>`. Their definitions declare `model.source: true`; flow-core hoists onto the instance.
122	- **Never author `model.context[]` on resource-node instances** — resource-node instances have no `model` block. For `uipath.core.*` resource nodes (rpa, agent, flow, agentic-process, api-workflow, hitl), the definition (from `registry get`) already carries `model.context[]` with `<bindings.{name}>` placeholders. Your job is to add matching entries to the top-level `bindings[]` array — two entries per resource node (`name` + `folderPath`) with `resourceKey` matching the definition's `model.bindings.resourceKey`. At BPMN emit, the runtime rewrites `<bindings.{name}>` → `=bindings.{id}` via `(resourceKey, name)` matching. Without the top-level `bindings[]` entries, `uip maestro flow validate` passes but `uip maestro flow debug` fails with "Folder does not exist or the user does not have access to the folder." See the resource plugin's `impl.md`.
123	- **Never put a `ui` block on node instances** — position and size belong in the top-level `layout.nodes` object. Nodes with `"ui": { "position": ... }` use the wrong format and may not render correctly in Studio Web.
124	- **Never skip `flow format` before publish or debug** — without it, hand-written `layout` data renders as misshapen rectangles in Studio Web (the MST-9061 failure mode). See rule #12 above for the format step.
125	- **Never validate after every individual edit** — intermediate flow states (e.g., node added but not yet wired) are expected to be invalid. Run `uip maestro flow validate` once after the full build is complete.
126	- **Never use `console.log` in script nodes** — `console` is not available in the Jint runtime. Use `return { debug: value }` to inspect values.
127	- **Never forget output mapping on End nodes** — every `out` variable in `variables.globals` must have a `source` expression in every reachable End node's `outputs`. Missing mappings cause silent runtime failures.
128	- **Never update `in` variables** — only `inout` variables can be modified via `variableUpdates`. Input variables are read-only after flow start.
129	- **Never reference parent-scope `$vars` inside a subflow** — subflows have isolated scope. Pass values explicitly via subflow inputs.
130	- **Never use `core.action.http` (v1)** — the v1 node is deprecated for all HTTP requests (both connector-authenticated and manual). For connector-auth, v1's `authenticationType: "connection"` input does not pass IS credentials at runtime. Use `core.action.http.v2` (Managed HTTP Request) for every HTTP node. See [http/planning.md](references/plugins/http/planning.md).
131	- **Never hand-write `definitions[]` or `inputs.*` for managed HTTP nodes** — use `uip maestro flow node add` (with `--input` for `branches` / `timeout` / `retryCount`) and `uip maestro flow node configure` (for `inputs.detail`). These are the only supported authoring paths. Hand-written `definitions[]` strips required manifest fields; hand-written `inputs.detail` misses `essentialConfiguration` and fails at runtime. See [http/impl.md](references/plugins/http/impl.md).
132	- **Never write `$vars.X` (or `$metadata.X`, `$self.X`) without `=js:` in value fields** — `flow validate` flags this as MST-9107. See rule #11 above and [shared/node-output-wiring.md](../shared/node-output-wiring.md) for the per-node-type field reference.
133	- **Never reuse a reference ID (mailbox folder, Slack channel, Jira project, Google Sheet, etc.) from a prior flow or session** — reference IDs are scoped to the specific authenticated account behind the connection. A `parentFolderId` from one Outlook mailbox is invalid in another; a Slack channel ID from one workspace is invalid in another. A reused ID passes `flow validate` and `node configure` cleanly, then faults silently at runtime with no resolvable error. Always re-resolve via `uip is resources run list <connector-key> <objectName> --connection-id <CURRENT_CONNECTION_ID> --output json` against the connection bound to this flow — do not paste a value you saw in another flow. See [connector/impl.md — Step 4](references/plugins/connector/impl.md) and [connector-trigger/impl.md — Step 3](references/plugins/connector-trigger/impl.md).
134	- **Never include `[*]` literally in a connector `bodyParameters` / `queryParameters` / `pathParameters` key** — `[*]` in `requestFields[].name` is an array marker, not part of the wire key. Strip it and pass an array value of the field's `dataType` (e.g. `"fields.labels[*]"` → `"fields.labels": ["a", "b"]`). Supported only when `[*]` is the name suffix; `[*].` (segments after) is not authorable. `flow validate` misses this; runtime rejects the key. See [connector/impl.md — Step 6b](references/plugins/connector/impl.md) for the full table including expression-value handling.
